split_law.law: Every rung has train chunks, a validation buffer freshly split from the train pool, and a gate heldout. Consolidation may consult only the validation buffer plus previously-passed-rung replay rows; the gate heldout is never consulted by updates.
split_law.m3_fast_layer: contrastive chunk updates on a temporary fast overlay
split_law.m4_slow_layer: merge fast into slow only when validation and prior replay do not regress
split_law.supersedes: per-key precision promotion criterion retired in Phase 1
